title: Giant raccoons and the toe implant

tellings.quote: uh had some a weird experience uh where uh I saw these giant raccoons in my backyard and uh when I was at the house alone one night

plain: One night when he was home alone in Fillmore, California, the scientist Steve Colbern says he saw "giant raccoons" in his backyard, a strange experience he connects to an implant in his toe. Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells Michels this as something that happened to him, and he ties it to the work of Roger Leir, a surgeon who removed such objects. If true, it would mean he was himself one of the people whose bodies he studies.
